variants.name: E16 · BrushedMetal-Tigert
variants.description: E16 BrushedMetal-Tigert (Tigert/Rasterman, the DR16 default): light brushed-aluminium frames, bevelled bronze gem buttons and turquoise desktop/Edoc backgrounds; chrome in black on metal, timeline in white on teal.

tokens.--cpd-font-family-sans: "Lucida Grande", "Lucida Sans Unicode", "Lucida Sans", "DejaVu Sans", sans-serif

variants.name: E17 · Dark Glow
variants.description: E17 (0.17) default dark theme: vgrad_med_dark #303030→#111111 bars, glossy shine strips, black recessed selection wells and the #3399FF glow on focus, selection and sliders.

variants.name: Enlightenment · Current
variants.description: Current Enlightenment (0.25–0.27, EFL elementary theme): flat greys straight from colorclasses.edc (:bg #404040, :bg-dim #303030, :bg-dark #202020), thin #3399FF selection lines, orange #FF9933 as second accent.

variants.name: Edje Aurora
variants.description: Mashup: E17 glossy structure with an aurora gradient (teal #2EE6C5 → cyan #33A1FF → violet #9B6BFF → magenta #FF5FC8) drifting behind glass shelves; cyan focus glow, magenta mentions.

variants.name: Moksha Ember
variants.description: Mashup: warm charcoal (#16120F) Moksha-style E17 structure, E16 brushed-copper title bars with Tigert's bronze gem buttons, E's own second accent #FF9933 as ember glow, amber pulse on unread, crimson highlights.

variants.name: Ganymede Neon Steel
variants.description: Mashup: E16 BlueSteel slate (#2D3243/#41475A) and Ganymede cobalt bevels (#3263E5) as brushed steel, lit by neon cyan #33E0FF and E magenta #FF3399, lime #99FF33 presence, Terminology-style scanlines in code blocks.

variants.name: Enlightenment · Usable
variants.description: E17/E-current look tuned for daily chat: brighter text (#EDEDED on #2C2C2C), visible 1px borders, solid 2px focus rings with only a subtle glow, no text glow, no gloss on content, bigger hit areas, Element affordances kept.

variants.name: Enlightenment · Aurora Cycle
variants.description: Daylight cycle by local clock: dawn (soft lilac/rose light, violet accent), day (light brushed steel, E-blue #1A5DB3), dusk (ember charcoal, #FF9933), night (deep blue-black with the E17 #3399FF glow). 2 s cross-fades unless reduced motion.
